caption: The video captures a top-down close view of a dark cooking pan whose left interior glows with a bright brushed-metal sheen. A rectangular, pale-yellow stick of butter rests diagonally in the center, already seated in a pool of melted butter that foams most visibly along its right edge. The solid stick holds essentially the same position, orientation and shape throughout the excerpt, showing no translation or rotation. Around it, the liquid pool and its frothy boundary creep slightly outward, the dark left edge advancing a little farther into the pan. The foam on the right continuously churns and rearranges its bubble pattern, marking ongoing melting and bubbling at the edges rather than a single event. The bright metallic reflection on the pan's wall remains fixed, indicating a stationary viewpoint while the physical changes unfold. No new object enters the frame, and the process neither starts nor finishes here. The melted pool's slow spread and the restless foam carry the entire motion of the clip.
